entities.summary: Samer el Nahhal (b. 1975-07-11, Espoo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Espoo and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
